vertebrae.scoring.overlap.auto_k_for_class(n_class, min_k=10, max_k=50, min_samples_per_cluster=5)[source]

Resolve automatic k for a single class.

Parameters:

  • n_class (int) – Number of samples in the class.

  • min_k (int) – Lower target for automatic k resolution.

  • max_k (int) – Maximum allowed k.

  • min_samples_per_cluster (int) – Minimum samples expected per cluster.

Returns:

Resolved k value.

Raises:

ValueError – If the class has fewer than two samples.

Return type:

int

vertebrae.scoring.overlap.resolve_kmeans_k(y, config, return_warnings=False)[source]

Resolve MiniBatchKMeans k values per class.

Parameters:

  • y (Any) – Class labels.

  • config (vertebrae.config.OverlapScoringConfig) – Overlap scoring configuration.

  • return_warnings (bool) – Whether to also return warning strings.

Returns:

Mapping from class labels to resolved k values. When return_warnings is true, returns (k_per_class, warnings).

Return type:

Union[Dict[Any, int], Tuple[Dict[Any, int], List[str]]]

class vertebrae.scoring.overlap.OverlapIndexScorer(config=None)[source]

Internal adapter for MiniBatchKMeans-backed OverlapIndex scoring.

Parameters:

config (Optional[vertebrae.config.OverlapScoringConfig]) – Optional scoring configuration.

score(Z, y, seed=None)[source]

Score dense or sparse embeddings with OverlapIndex.

Sparse embeddings are validated and densified at this boundary because the configured OverlapIndex backend consumes dense arrays.

Parameters:

  • Z (Any) – Dense or sparse embedding matrix.

  • y (Any) – Class labels.

  • seed (Optional[int]) – Optional random seed forwarded to MiniBatchKMeans.

Returns:

Structured scoring result.

Raises:

  • ImportError – If overlapindex is not installed.

  • ValueError – If embeddings are invalid or too large to densify.

Return type:

OverlapScoreResult
